item.title: 55 Free Horror Movies Streaming in December
item.description: The entire MASTERS OF HORROR series is finally available for streaming, along with GREEN ROOM and THE SILENCE OF THE LAMBS, making this a very scary December.

item.title: Jimmy Crystal Returns In New 28 YEARS LATER: THE BONE TEMPLE Trailer
item.description: The new trailer for 28 YEARS LATER: THE BONE TEMPLE teases the return of Jack O'Connell as the maniacal Jimmy Crystal.

item.title: The Games Continue In READY OR NOT 2: HERE I COME First Trailer
item.description: The deadly games continue for Samara Weaving in the first trailer for READY OR NOT 2: HERE I COME.

item.title: Take Home Some Iconic Horror Movie Props With New Julien’s Auctions Sale
item.description: Thanks to TCM and Julien's Auctions, fans can take home iconic props from films like JURASSIC PARK, TWIN PEAKS: FIRE WALK WITH ME, and more.

item.title: Exclusive Interview: The Creators Of The “Shared-Footage” Horror Film MAN FINDS TAPE
item.description: Ahead of MAN FINDS TAPE hitting VOD and theaters on Friday, directors Peter Hall and Paul Gandersman join us to talk cryptids, trypophobia and the 'wormy element' of their found footage horror.

item.title: James Wan Is Producing A New PARANORMAL ACTIVITY Movie
item.description: Blumhouse and Atomic Monster are joining forces for a new PARANORMAL ACTIVITY movie, with horror franchise master James Wan producing.

item.title: See David Cronenberg’s SHIVERS On The Big Screen For Free
item.description: Want to see David Cronenberg’s SHIVERS in 35MM on the big screen for free? You can do precisely that! We’ve got all the details right here.

item.title: Another Iconic Slasher Is Getting His Own Video Game Next Year
item.description: Now that Jason and Leatherface have had their turn, Michael Myers is stepping up to the plate for his own slasher video game next year.

item.title: Keke Palmer Investigates THE ‘BURBS In First Trailer For Peacock’s New Mystery Series
item.description: Keke Palmer is one nosy neighbor in the first trailer for THE 'BURBS, Peacock's new mystery series inspired by Joe Dante's 1989 cult classic.

item.title: YOUNG SHERLOCK HOLMES: Why You Need To Watch This Criminally Underseen Adventure
item.description: To an entire generation, this Steven Spielberg produced Victorian era adventure may feel like a fever dream. But it’s real and it deserves some love! Written by GREMLINS screenwriter Chris Columbus, we’re celebrating 40 years of YOUNG SHERLOCK HOLMES.
